name: cloudflare-image-workbench
description: An open-source editorial image lab built on Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run build

PUBLIC_UPLOADS_ENABLED.description: Leave `false` to deploy the public recipes only. Set `true` only after Turnstile, both secrets, and the R2 lifecycle rules are configured; see the README's **Enable visitor uploads** checklist.

TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY.description: Site key of a [Turnstile widget](https://developers.cloudflare.com/turnstile/get-started/) for your Worker's hostname. Required, with `TURNSTILE_SECRET`, before uploads can be enabled.

TURNSTILE_SECRET.description: Secret key of the same Turnstile widget. Leave blank while uploads are paused; never use Turnstile's always-pass test secret in a deployment.

ADMIN_REVIEW_TOKEN.description: Operator token for the review and takedown API. Generate it with `openssl rand -hex 32`; base64 values are rejected. Leave blank to disable the operator API.

MEDIA_BUCKET_NAME.description: Must equal the name of the `MEDIA` R2 bucket. The Queue consumer ignores upload events from any other bucket.

START_WORKFLOW_ON_UPLOAD.description: `true` starts processing directly from the upload route, so uploads work before an R2 event notification exists. Set `false` once the notification feeds the Queue.
